subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this exact gateway reload change, must merge require redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence, or is the focused lifecycle regression suite sufficient?
rationale: The contributor cannot produce a real provider session from the available environment, and repository policy treats external-PR real behavior proof as a merge gate unless an owner deliberately accepts an exception.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup posts redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B triggers the reload.

options.title: Accept focused gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-level proof for this head and rely on the targeted gateway lifecycle regressions plus normal CI.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup posts redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B triggers the reload.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work establishes direct familiarity with the same account-aware gateway reload boundary.
